tools.name: check_research_status
tools.description: Retrieve the proposed scope, price offer, payment details, operator decision or research response using your receipt_id. Keep the receipt private. Use respond_to_research_offer to confirm or correct a proposed scope, or accept or decline an unexpired quote. If no response is available, try again lat

tools.name: respond_to_research_offer
tools.description: Respond using your private receipt_id. confirm_scope or correct_scope requires a proposed scope; correct_scope, for an Answer only, also requires correction text (for a Brief or Map, send a changed question as a new request). accept_quote or decline_quote requires an unexpired quote; decline_quote m

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Free. Check whether SNTL already holds verified material on a space company or topic before asking a question. Returns counts only: verified claims and market signals that match, the date of the newest, and the names matched. No content is returned; to receive research, use submit_research_interest.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "respond_to_research_offer" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Respond using your private receipt_id. confirm_scope or correct_scope requires a proposed scope; correct_scope, for an Answer only, also requires correction tex…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "submit_research_interest" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Record a research enquiry about a space company or market. Submission records demand for review. It is accepted as a research Answer: a proposed scope follows at once for you to confirm, then a price offer. Nothing is owed until payment. Keep the receipt and return with check_research_status. Collec" → after: "Ask SNTL one research question about a space company or market, and choose the product. answer (€5 to 31 December 2026, then €10): accepted or declined automatically. brief (€250, two to five pages) or map (€999, a segment mapped): SNTL accepts or declines the scope; on acceptance a fixed-price quot"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
